name: Thanatos
source:
You're a private detective. One day you're shocked to read in an article that your colleague was shot with a swarm of bullets. Once you set on a trail you get a floppy disk that contains information on a trading company that operates secret medicine "Thanatos" that gives enormous strength.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-march-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你是一名私家侦探。一天，你从报道中震惊地得知，一名同行身中数枪而死。循着线索调查后，你得到一张软盘，其中记录着某贸易公司的资料。该公司暗中经营一种名为“塔纳托斯”的药物，服用后能获得惊人力量。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-march-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
